title: FMB Locked Generation Recipe Contracts
description: Host-only generation and declared-dependency records. Structural validation does not certify byte identity, dependency closure, or semantic regeneration.

post_export_journal_entry.description: One journaled post-export intervention of a generation output directory (post-export/NN-<name>.json): the intervened image's SHA-256 before and after it, its ordinal, UTC times and status. A resumed run replays only entries that are not completed and refuses an image whose hash differs from the chain.
